title_sq: Shume prane TEG ofrojme apartamente ne shitje 2+1 dhe 3+1.
description_sq:
MUNDESI PAGESE ME KESTE!
By Long Hill eshte nje rezidence qe kthen jeten e perditshme ne privilegj.
Vetem pak minuta larg qendres se Tiranes dhe shume prane TEG, po ngrihet nje rezidence qe nuk eshte thjesht vendbanim, por nje menyre e re jetese.
Rezidenca ofron tipologji 2+1 dhe 3+1, me hapesira të bollshme dhe drite natyrale.
-Siperfaqe bruto 143.37 m²
-Siperfaqe neto 128.19 m²
-Kati 0 me oborr
Apartamenti organizohet;
Sallon dhe ambjent gatimi
2 dhoma gjumi
2 tualete
1 dhome lavanderi
1 ballkon
oborr
Çdo detaj, nga arkitektura bashkëkohore tek dizajni i brendshem, eshte menduar per te kombinuar estetiken me funksionalitetin maksimal.
Nje projekt ku natyra dhe komoditeti behen nje, krijuar per ata qe kerkojne ambient unik, qetesi dhe stil modern.
Qendrueshmeria dhe energjia inteligjente:
Inkorporimi i paneleve diellore garanton 0% kosto per energjine elektrike, duke reduktuar ndikimin ne mjedis dhe duke sjelle nje menyre jetese me te gjelber.
Facilitetet qe bejne diferencen:
Parkim i dedikuar per çdo rezident dhe pedonale per qarkullim nen toke.
Ambjente sherbimi dhe komoditet per rezidentet.
Hapsira rekreative: palester moderne dhe fushe tenisi.
Ndertimi i Universiteti UET brenda rezidences ofron nje mundesi unike arsimore per studentet, duke kombinuar edukimin me komoditetine jeteses prane shtepise.
Ekip i dedikuar për mirëmbajtjen e hapësirave dhe ambientit.
Nje mundesi e rralle per te jetuar prane qytetit, pa sakrifikuar paqen dhe luksin.
Zbulo apartamentin tend te ardhshem dhe behu pjese e nje rezidence ku komoditeti merr kuptim te ri.
Per me teper informacion me kontaktoni.
title_en: Very close to TEG, we offer 2+1 and 3+1 apartments for sale.
description_en: POSSIBILITY OF PAYMENT IN CASH! By Long Hill is a residence that turns everyday life into a privilege. Just a few minutes away from the center of Tirana and very close to TEG, a residence is being built that is not just a residence, but a new way of life. The residence offers 2+1 and 3+1 typologies, with ample spaces and natural light. -Gross area 143.37 m² -Net area 128.19 m² -Floor 0 with courtyard The apartment is organized; Living room and kitchen area 2 bedrooms 2 bathrooms 1 laundry room 1 patio balcony Every detail, from contemporary architecture to interior design, is designed to combine aesthetics with maximum functionality. A project where nature and comfort become one, created for those looking for a unique environment, tranquility and modern style. Sustainability and smart energy: The incorporation of solar panels guarantees 0% electricity costs, reducing the impact on the environment and bringing a greener lifestyle. Facilities that make the difference: Dedicated parking for every resident and pedestrians for underground circulation. Service facilities and comfort for residents. Recreational facilities: modern gymnasium and tennis courts. The UET University building within the residence offers a unique educational opportunity for students, combining education with the comfort of living close to home. Dedicated team for the maintenance of spaces and environment. A rare opportunity to live near the city, without sacrificing peace and luxury. Discover your future apartment and be part of a residence where comfort takes on a new meaning. For more information, contact me.
